description: This file contains unit tests for the AppState's remote configuration handling in a Swift project. It tests updating remote gateway configurations, token management, and preserving secret references across different connection modes.

classes.name: AppStateRemoteConfigTests
classes.description: Test suite for validating remote configuration update and token handling logic in AppState.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigSetsTrimmedToken
methods.description: Tests that a remote gateway config correctly trims whitespace from the token.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsTokenWhenBlank
methods.description: Ensures that an empty or whitespace-only token string results in clearing the token.

methods.name: syncedGatewayRootPreservesObjectTokenAcrossModeAndTransportChangesWhenUntouched
methods.description: Validates that secret references are preserved across mode and transport changes when the token is untouched.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigReplacesObjectTokenWhenUserEntersPlaintext
methods.description: Checks that entering a new plaintext token replaces the secret reference.

methods.name: updatedRemoteGatewayConfigClearsObjectTokenOnlyAfterExplicitEdit
methods.description: Verifies that secret references are preserved unless an explicit change clears the token.
